source.title: WCA Regulations - January 2026
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

The WCA Regulations Committee would like to inform you about a new version of the WCA Regulations. This version will be in effect for competitions beginning on, or after, January 1st, 2026. <!-- break -->

You can review all changes in [this comparison on GitHub](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/compare/official-2025-07-17..official-2026-01-01). You can click on “Files changed” to see the complete files of the Regulations, where all changes and additions are marked green and removals are marked red.

You can read a more detailed description of changes in this [explainer document](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1YiJ988FsIWwBnj9D5IZoNEaXnnWP5IDeHqROcJqgQtE/edit?usp=sharing). Below is a summary of the changes in the new version of the Regulations.

Major Changes:

* Introduce Head to Head format [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/62)
* Introduce Dual Rounds [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/50)
* Change 3x3 Blindfolded format to Best of 5 [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/48)
* Simplify Regulation 2i (electronics) [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/60)
* Introduce Approved Timer List [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/29)
* 5x5 & Megaminx misscramble requirements [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/13/)
* Allow certain extras to be scrambled on an unsolved puzzle [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/14)

Minor Changes:

* Remove gender from 2c [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/12)
* Remove Board discretion in 2e [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/38)
* Remove stateless recognition [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/37)
* Restrict 2s++ accommodations [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/54)
* Remove 2t [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/21)
* Clarify 3d1b color blind accommodations [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/36)
* Add "reasonably" to 3h2a [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/30)
* Clock puzzle legality [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/46)
* Forbid photographing scrambles [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/51)
* Clarify intentional puzzle defects [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/56)
* Clarify Square-1 scrambles [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/9)
* Clarify recording no results [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/17)
* Clarify record recognition [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/18)
* Clarify record timing [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/61)
* Clarify extra timing [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/35)
* 9l1++ consistency update [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/15)
* Clarify amending round format [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/53)
* Restrict adding rounds after final [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/53)
* Remove 10h [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/27)
* Remove 11e1+ [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/6)
* Clarify order of results [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/24)
* Note attempt order for combined cumulative rounds [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/57)
* Clarify one minute to start attempt [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/28)
* Clarify Square-1 moves in inspection [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/11)
* Clarify timer start hand position [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/49)
* Change A5b assistance [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/34)
* Change A6c default to +2 [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/32)
* Clarify A6e (touching the puzzle after the solve) [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/33)
* Clarify time format [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/58)
* Add discretion to A7c3 penalty [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/44)
* Clarify A7c8 attestation [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/31)
* Remove A7g+++ example [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/10)
* Clarify B3c exception [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/25)
* Add discretion to FMC penalties [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/19)
* Clarify penalty for revealing FMC scramble [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/23)
* Clarify Multi-Blind latecomers [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/41)
* Remove H1b1++ [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/16)
* Generalize H1e [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/40)

translation.title: WCA 竞赛规则更新（2026 年 1 月）
translation.content:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

WCA 规则委员会在此通知，新版《WCA 竞赛规则》将适用于 2026 年 1 月 1 日及之后开始的比赛。

所有改动可在 [GitHub 版本对比](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/compare/official-2025-07-17..official-2026-01-01)中查看。点击“Files changed”即可查看完整规则文件，其中新增和修改的内容标为绿色，删除的内容标为红色。

更详细的说明见这份[改动说明文档](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1YiJ988FsIWwBnj9D5IZoNEaXnnWP5IDeHqROcJqgQtE/edit?usp=sharing)。以下是新版规则的主要改动。

主要改动：

* 引入一对一赛制（Head to Head） [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/62)
* 引入双重轮 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/50)
* 三阶盲拧改为五次取最佳成绩 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/48)
* 简化规则 2i（电子设备） [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/60)
* 引入认可计时器名单 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/29)
* 调整五阶和五魔方错误打乱的判定要求 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/13/)
* 允许部分额外还原在未复原的魔方上打乱 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/14)

次要改动：

* 从规则 2c 中移除性别信息 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/12)
* 移除规则 2e 中董事会酌情决定的规定 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/38)
* 取消无国籍身份认定 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/37)
* 限制指南 2s++ 中的特殊安排 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/54)
* 删除规则 2t [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/21)
* 明确规则 3d1b 中对色盲选手的特殊安排 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/36)
* 在规则 3h2a 中加入“合理地” [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/30)
* 明确魔表的合规要求 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/46)
* 禁止拍摄打乱 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/51)
* 明确故意造成魔方缺陷的相关规定 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/56)
* 明确 Square-1 打乱要求 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/9)
* 明确无成绩的记录方式 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/17)
* 明确纪录的认定 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/18)
* 明确纪录认定的时间规则 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/61)
* 明确给予额外还原的时间限制 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/35)
* 统一指南 9l1++ 的表述 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/15)
* 明确轮次赛制的修改 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/53)
* 限制在决赛后增设轮次 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/53)
* 删除规则 10h [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/27)
* 删除指南 11e1+ [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/6)
* 明确成绩的顺序 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/24)
* 说明合并累计时限轮次中的还原顺序 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/57)
* 明确须在一分钟内开始还原 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/28)
* 明确 Square-1 在观察期间允许的转动 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/11)
* 明确启动计时器时的手部位置 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/49)
* 修改规则 A5b 中有关帮助的规定 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/34)
* 将规则 A6c 的默认处罚改为加罚 2 秒 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/32)
* 明确规则 A6e（还原结束后触碰魔方） [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/33)
* 明确时间的记录格式 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/58)
* 允许对规则 A7c3 的处罚酌情处理 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/44)
* 明确规则 A7c8 中的确认要求 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/31)
* 删除指南 A7g+++ 中的示例 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/10)
* 明确规则 B3c 的例外情况 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/25)
* 允许对最少步的处罚酌情处理 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/19)
* 明确泄露最少步打乱的处罚 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/23)
* 明确多盲迟到的处理 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/41)
* 删除指南 H1b1++ [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/16)
* 扩大规则 H1e 的适用范围 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations-january-2026/pull/40)

notes: 已读原文引用PR61（9i2纪录时序）及PR35（额外还原仅能在比赛期间给予），核实timing语境。
